data.title: Ripple's David Schwartz Once Held 26 Million XRP, 1,500 Bitcoin and 40,000 Ethereum. Why Did He Sell Over 90% of His Crypto?
data.description: Former Ripple CTO David Schwartz once held 26 million XRP, 1,500 Bitcoin and 40,000 Ethereum. Here's why he sold over 90% of it.
